Also can narrow export with date range or filter. So answer: it's a hard cap for single export; to get full history, use scheduled export to cloud storage or split into smaller exports. arguments.message: The 10,000‑row limit applies to a single export you run from the dashboard – it’s a hard cap to keep the download in the browser. If you need the entire history in one go, set up a scheduled export to cloud storage – that export isn’t subject to the 10,000‑row cap. Alternatively, you can split the data into smaller exports (e.g., by month) and combine them later.
